Elements null/null per THE PHYSICAL RULE (corpus elem physical; physical is never an element token). Variant-scoped attributes OFF core row (7.2): Lightning Swarmblade (Tornado/Storm Bolt), Frostbite Swarmblade (LE Frostbite is ALSO a no-home cold-DoT -- WITHHOLD + note), BearSwarm hybrid, Locust leveling.
